items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: I had a friend, Mr. Peer.

ctx.x: I was wondering about your records and Russ Papalia. He played trouble with me on the records.

But I would say here and now there is nothing of distinction attached to my records. I made a terrible mistake. A man came down here. No, I had a friend, Mr. Peer. He was a man that was doing his own piano house. And he was friendly with, no, I'm going to get the names all wrong. Mr. Peer was the president of OK Records. He played a fair golf game. And he played a fair golf game. But he thought he played a better one. So I let him win the second nine. First thing your secretary says, Mr. Peer beat you on the…
Yeah. But he liked me. He made my kid.
